The main takeaway from our work is that
the compression-based approach to designing fixed-parameter algorithms is not only applicable to NP-complete problems, but that it can even lead to deterministic fixed-parameter algorithms.
, in contrast to the standard approach, it is possible to design deterministic fixed-parameter algorithms that are based on compression techniques and do not rely on randomization.

, in some cases, the compression-based approach is able to outperform the state of the art in terms of the running time, even if the compression-based approach does not yield the best known upper bound on the parameterized running time.
